name: DESI-132.2396-01.3110 (Hubble)
blurb: DESI-132.2396-01.3110, a candidate strong gravitational lens, seen by Hubble.
label: desi1322396013110-hubble
story: Here a foreground galaxy may be acting as a cosmic lens, bending the light of a more distant galaxy behind it. Survey images showed an arc on one side and a counterarc on the other, and Hubble took a sharper look to confirm whether the lens is real.

claims.text: DESI-132.2396-01.3110 is a new Grade A strong lens candidate found in DESI DR1
The lens is a foreground galaxy and the lensed source is a more distant galaxy
It shows an arc and a counterarc in survey images
Hubble program 18085 observed DESI lens candidates to confirm them
